summary: End-to-end testing of Pan Čung calculators iteration: hero floating cards (2 only), numbers strip (2 numbers), interactive calculators (invest/mortgage/fire/health) on homepage and /kalkulacky page, contact prefill, VI language, mobile responsive, other pages, and backend /api/leads with source='calculator'. All acceptance criteria met with 2 minor issues.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate data-testid='fire-age' used on both the age Slider input AND the result <div> showing FIRE age. page.locator('[data-testid=fire-age]') returns 2 elements which breaks testability and violates unique-id convention.

issues: Console errors: <path> attribute d: Expected moveto path command ('M' or 'm'), 'undefined'. Multiple occurrences (12 during a normal session). Likely LineChart/Sparkline receiving empty/undefined data on initial render before framer-motion animate value stabilizes; the animate={{ d }} prop is 'undefined' on first render. Non-blocking (chart visually renders) but pollutes console.

action_items: Rename either the FireCalc slider testId or the result testId (e.g. keep slider as 'fire-age-input' and result as 'fire-age', or slider 'fire-age' and result 'fire-age-result') to make data-testid unique.

In charts.jsx LineChart, guard motion.path animate={{ d }} against undefined during first render (e.g. only pass d in animate when pts is non-empty), or ensure InvestCalc/FireCalc initial data array is never length 0.
critical_code_review_comments: data-testid uniqueness — Playwright convention requires each testid to identify a single element; FireCalc violates this.
LineChart accepts data without validation; when parents pass an empty array, `pts[n-1]` is undefined causing SVG path warnings. Add early return / default when data.length===0.
server.py is compact and clean; ObjectId excluded via projection {_id:0} in list/get endpoints — good.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all functional criteria met, 1 testid duplication + benign console warnings)

seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_CalcUser lead via /api/leads POST/DELETE.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All calculator math verified against expected values in review request (invest 3 008 507 Kč, mortgage 25 475/4 370 958 Kč, fire target 12 M Kč, health 58→68). /kalkulacky?k=<tab> works and clicking tabs updates URL. CTA prefills textarea correctly. Mobile 390px has zero horizontal overflow on / and /kalkulacky. VI translation renders labels correctly (hero-card-0='7 năm kinh nghiệm', hero-card-1='459+ khách hàng hài lòng' — numbers intentionally differ from CS which is 8 / 500+).

detailed_verifications.hero_cards: hero-card-0='8 | let zkušeností', hero-card-1='500+ | spokojených klientů', hero-card-2 absent. No 'ILUSTRATIVNÍ DATA' / '4,82 M' / '+12,4' / '68 %' cards in hero.
detailed_verifications.numbers_strip: number-0='8', number-1='500+', number-2 absent, no 'X,X mld' anywhere.
detailed_verifications.route_k_param: /kalkulacky?k=mortgage opens mortgage tab active; clicking fire updates URL to ?k=fire; ?k=xyz falls back to invest.
detailed_verifications.cta_prefill: textarea prefilled 'Investiční kalkulačka: 5 000 Kč / měsíc · 20 let · 7 % p.a. → 3 008 507 Kč'.
detailed_verifications.backend: GET /api/health 200, POST /api/leads {source:'calculator', calc:{...}} 201, GET /api/leads/{id} 200, invalid source rejected 422.
